<!--
name: "Tool Description: Computer left_mouse_up"
description: "Describes the computer-use left_mouse_up tool for releasing the left mouse button at the current cursor position"

variables:
  - "FRONTMOST_APPLICATION_ALLOWLIST_GUARD"

Release the left mouse button at the current cursor position. ${FRONTMOST_APPLICATION_ALLOWLIST_GUARD} Pairs with left_mouse_down. Safe to call even if the button is not currently held.
